from dataclasses import replace
import psycopg
import pytest
from agent_guard.contracts.execution import ExecutionError, ExecutionErrorCode
from agent_guard.contracts.ledger import LedgerError, ErrorCode, AcceptDisposition
from agent_guard.tools.catalog import CatalogQuote, CatalogQuoteLine
from tests.fixtures.execution import constraints_for, permission_for, order_params
from tests.fixtures.dbstate import fetch_counts, fetch_counters
from tests.integration.test_execution_concurrency import _race

@pytest.mark.parametrize('error_type',[SystemExit,KeyboardInterrupt])
def test_oracle_baseexception_is_collected_and_rethrown_in_caller(error_type):
    error=error_type('synthetic owned racer')
    def fail(): raise error
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError,match='unexpected race worker exception') as caught:
        _race([lambda: 'completed',fail])
    assert caught.value.__cause__ is error

@pytest.mark.parametrize('extra_sku',['sku-extra','sku-0'])
def test_terminal_candidate_cannot_bypass_item_bound_or_replay(a2,extra_sku):
    skus=tuple(f'sku-{i}' for i in range(256))
    a2.catalog.replace_quote(CatalogQuote('quote-001','1','supplier-001','req-001',tuple(CatalogQuoteLine(s,1,1) for s in skus)))
    permission=permission_for(a2.tree,chain=tuple(constraints_for(i,skus=skus) for i in range(3)))
    inv=a2.tree.invocation(tool_id='procurement.order.create',params=order_params(items=tuple((s,1) for s in skus)))
    first=a2.service.accept_invocation(inv,permission)
    assert a2.service.run_operation(first.operation_id).status=='SUCCEEDED'
    a2.catalog.remove_quote('quote-001','1')
    before=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)
    grants=[a2.tree.root_id,a2.tree.mid_id,a2.tree.leaf_id]
    counters={g:fetch_counters(a2.gateway_dsn,g) for g in grants}
    bad=replace(inv,proof_jti='r2-over',canonical_params=order_params(items=tuple((s,1) for s in skus)+((extra_sku,1),)))
    with pytest.raises(ExecutionError) as caught:a2.service.accept_invocation(bad,permission)
    assert caught.value.code is ExecutionErrorCode.INVALID_PARAMS
    assert fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)==before
    assert {g:fetch_counters(a2.gateway_dsn,g) for g in grants}==counters
    fresh=replace(inv,proof_jti='r2-fresh')
    retry=a2.service.accept_invocation(fresh,permission)
    assert retry.disposition is AcceptDisposition.EXISTING and retry.operation_id==first.operation_id
    after=fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)
    assert after==dict(before,ag_proofs=before['ag_proofs']+1)
    with pytest.raises(LedgerError) as replay:a2.service.accept_invocation(fresh,permission)
    assert replay.value.code is ErrorCode.REPLAY
    assert fetch_counts(a2.gateway_dsn)==after
    assert {g:fetch_counters(a2.gateway_dsn,g) for g in grants}==counters
    assert all(v==dict(amount_reserved=0,amount_settled=256,calls_reserved=0,calls_settled=1) for v in counters.values())
    with psycopg.connect(a2.downstream_dsn) as c:assert c.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM ds_orders').fetchone()==(1,)
    with psycopg.connect(a2.gateway_dsn) as c:
        assert c.execute('SELECT phase,count(*) FROM ag_ledger_events GROUP BY phase ORDER BY phase').fetchall()==[('RESERVE',1),('SETTLE',1)]
        assert c.execute('SELECT receipt_status,receipt_jws FROM ag_receipt_outbox').fetchall()==[('PENDING',None)]
